result.finding: Dockerfiles are generated at deploy time by scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh. Both the web and worker Dockerfiles are minimal single-stage definitions with no RUN instructions and a single COPY instruction. The base image eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine contributes approximately 5-7 inherited layers, plus 1 WORKDIR layer and 1 COPY layer, yielding an estimated 7-9 layers per image. No layer optimization issues (such as split RUN commands) are present since no RUN instructions are used at all.
evidence: Dockerfiles are dynamically generated by scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh (lines 272-295), not committed to repo
Web Dockerfile instructions: FROM (1), WORKDIR (1), COPY (1), EXPOSE (0 layers), ENTRYPOINT (0 layers)
Worker Dockerfile instructions: FROM (1), WORKDIR (1), COPY (1), ENTRYPOINT (0 layers)
No RUN instructions in either Dockerfile — no additional package installation layers
Single-stage build (one FROM per Dockerfile) — no multi-stage optimization
